lesson: Stage autoreview found THREE P2 defects in the affordance derivation; fix exactly these, add one pinned test each, then re-run the touched suites (coordinator, permission-card-affordances, inline-agent-loop-tools) plus npx tsc --noEmit and npm run check:architecture. (1) apps/core/src/runtime/permission-decision-coordinator.ts:228 — when the trusted-root stage returns `learn`, the prompt tail is invoked with `undefined` BEFORE the new tail context (with canonicalRoot) is constructed, so the inline path derives the place candidate as no_root and can never offer or store the folder decision on the trusted-root learning path; build the final tail context (including canonicalRoot) first and pass it to the tail on that path too — pin: coordinator test where the trusted-root stage returns learn and the tail receives the canonical root. (2) apps/core/src/application/permissions/permission-card-affordances.ts:167 — folder eligibility must require BOTH a valid default kind candidate AND a valid canonical-root-derived place candidate (contract ruling 3); today it checks only the root and place, so a refused kind candidate with a valid place still renders remember_allow_place — pin: refused kind + valid place → no folder alternative. (3) apps/core/src/application/permissions/permission-card-affordances.ts:145 — the production prompt-model builder never supplies toolLabel and the affordance builder falls back only to request.displayName, so a high-risk tool with a known human/card label but no displayName never gets the trust-growth alternative; supply the label through the existing human-label derivation (permissionHumanToolLabel or its equivalent) at model construction on both prompt paths, with the fallback chain human label → the card's tool name → no alternative (owner ruling) — pin: tool with a card label but no displayName and three exact allows → "Allow all <label> actions" offered. The orchestrator commits, never you.
